title: Agent Behavioral Contracts II: Certifying Compositional Reliability Without Assuming Independence
abstract: arXiv:2608.12895v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Compositional reliability bounds for multi-agent systems multiply component reliabilities, a step licensed by a conditional-independence assumption that is routinely stated and rarely tested. We test it. Two instances of one model, in a two-agent handoff, co-fail on 90.0% of the missions on which either fails (log OR 6.66, 95% CI [6.38, 7.00]; phi 0.916), in a preregistered evaluation of 18,000 missions scored by deterministic code with no LLM judge. Substituting a different model reduces the association in six of six contrasts; substituting a different vendor, model already different, does not -- a registered hypothesis reported as a null.   The error is signed and runs against the operator: positive dependence inflates joint failure above the independence product, so redundancy is over-credited exactly when components share a model. translated_title: 代理行为契约II：无需假设独立性的组合可靠性认证
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12895v1 公告类型：新 摘要：多代理系统的组合可靠性边界通过乘以组件可靠性来计算，这一步骤基于条件独立性的假设，该假设常被陈述但很少被测试。我们对此进行了测试。在一个两代理交接场景中，同一模型的两个实例在任一失败的任务中，有90.0%的情况下共同失败（对数比值比6.66，95%置信区间[6.38, 7.00]；phi系数0.916），这是对18,000个任务进行的预注册评估，由确定性代码评分，无LLM法官参与。替换为不同模型在六个对比中均减少了关联性；替换为不同供应商，但模型已不同，则无此效果——这是一个注册假设，报告为零结果。该误差有符号且对操作者不利：正相关性将联合失败率提升至独立乘积之上，因此当组件共享模型时，冗余被过度信用。无假设的替代方案往往空洞，而拟合依赖模型更糟：我们证明了一个下界...
tldr: 本文通过实证和理论证明，多代理系统组合可靠性计算中条件独立性假设在共享模型时严重失效，导致冗余可靠性被高估，并提出需重新评估可靠性认证方法。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically and theoretically demonstrates that the conditional independence assumption in compositional reliability for multi-agent systems fails severely when components share a model, inflating redundancy credits, and calls for re-evaluating reliability certification methods.
